## Investigation Report

### Verdict / Confidence / Severity / Task Type

| Verdict | Confidence | Severity | Task Type |
|---|---|---|---|
| Confirmed | Confirmed | Medium | Correctness / focused regression fix |

### What Was Claimed

Issue #113 carries finding `VP-003`: an `npm tst` alias can bypass required test-script validation in verification preflight. The remediation must validate the current integration branch, fix the root cause, add focused regression coverage, and re-review the exact remediation head.

### What We Found

`packageScriptName` in `src/adapters/verification-preflight.ts` recognizes `test`, `run`, and `run-script`, but not npm's direct `t` and `tst` aliases. With `argv: ["npm", "tst"]`, it returns no script name and `preflightRequiredVerificationCommands` never checks whether the selected package defines `scripts.test`. The existing fixture reproduces the bypass: the repository root has no test script while `web/package.json` defines one.

### Root Cause

Direct package-manager test aliases are not normalized to the canonical `test` package script before manifest validation.

### Affected Files

- `src/adapters/verification-preflight.ts` — normalize npm `test`, `t`, and `tst` aliases.
- `test/adapters/verification-preflight.test.ts` — add regression coverage proving each direct npm test alias validates the selected package.

### Evidence

- `packageScriptName` currently checks `command === "test"` only before handling `run` and `run-script`.
- The preflight invokes `assertPackageScript` only when `packageScriptName` returns a script name.
- The existing fixture's root manifest lacks `scripts.test`; its `web` manifest contains `scripts.test`.
- The issue body records source finding `VP-003` at the cited preflight implementation and identifies the previously intended aliases.

### History Findings

The issue references source PR #110 and remediation commit `d174f8e9d8ff88c1a40b8a75c99489c76ef52e92`. The current frozen integration tree still lacks the cited alias handling, so this run treats the finding as active. No unrelated history or product change is required.

### Recommendation

Normalize direct npm aliases `test`, `t`, and `tst` to `test`, then exercise the same root-fails / package-cwd-passes behavior for all three aliases. Keep `run` and `run-script` handling unchanged.

### Related Issues

- Source issue: #94
- Source PR: #110
- Current remediation issue: #113
- Finding: `VP-003`

### Decomposition Assessment

This is a single bounded correctness change in one adapter and its focused test. It does not require decomposition, API changes, UX decisions, policy changes, or security-authority decisions.

### Acceptance Spec

- [ ] `npm test`, `npm t`, and `npm tst` all resolve to package script `test` during preflight.
- [ ] A required alias command fails when the selected package has no `scripts.test`.
- [ ] The same command passes when `cwd` selects a package defining `scripts.test`.
- [ ] Existing executable, cwd, and `run` / `run-script` behavior remains unchanged.
- [ ] `npm run check` passes and the exact remediation head is reviewed.
